command: cd /tmp/voice-gui-display; unset PIKAFISH_MAC_BACKEND; PIKAFISH_MAC_REQUIRE_DRIVER=1 PIKAFISH_STAGEA_ACCEL=1 PIKAFISH_STAGEB_ACCEL=verify XQ_GUI_INPUT=/run/voice-display.in ./xiangqi-gui-display-v3 </dev/null >gui-c80-accepted-verify.log 2>&1 & echo $! >gui-v3.pid; n=0; until grep -q "XQ LINUX PIKAFISH READY" gui-c80-accepted-verify.log; do sleep 1; n=$((n+1)); test "$n" -lt 80 || break; done; grep -E "MAC_RUNTIME|GATHER|KERNEL_RESIDENT|STAGEB_ACCEL_READY|PIKAFISH READY" gui-c80-accepted-verify.log; grep -q "XQ LINUX PIKAFISH READY" gui-c80-accepted-verify.log

cd /tmp/voice-gui-display; xqaudio-capture /tmp/c80-accepted-search.wav 6 >audio-final-search.log 2>&1 & ap=$!; printf "XQ_NEWGAME\nXQ_MOVE h2e2\n" > /run/voice-display.in; n=0; until grep -q "INJECT MOVE_PASS\|INJECT MOVE_FAIL" gui-c80-accepted-verify.log; do sleep 1; n=$((n+1)); test "$n" -lt 90 || break; done; wait "$ap"; ar=$?; cat audio-final-search.log; tail -25 gui-c80-accepted-verify.log; test "$ar" -eq 0 && grep -q "INJECT MOVE_PASS" gui-c80-accepted-verify.log

cd /tmp/voice-gui-display; printf "XQ_NEWGAME\n" > /run/voice-display.in; sleep 3; tail -4 gui-c80-accepted-verify.log; p=$(cat gui-v3.pid); kill "$p"; n=0; while kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; n=$((n+1)); test "$n" -lt 15 || break; done; ! kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null

cd /tmp/voice-gui-display; unset PIKAFISH_MAC_BACKEND; PIKAFISH_MAC_REQUIRE_DRIVER=1 PIKAFISH_STAGEA_ACCEL=1 PIKAFISH_STAGEB_ACCEL=1 XQ_GUI_INPUT=/run/voice-display.in ./xiangqi-gui-display-v3 </dev/null >gui-c80-accepted-normal.log 2>&1 & echo $! >gui-v3.pid; n=0; until grep -q "XQ LINUX PIKAFISH READY" gui-c80-accepted-normal.log; do sleep 1; n=$((n+1)); test "$n" -lt 80 || break; done; grep -E "MAC_RUNTIME|KERNEL_RESIDENT|STAGEB_ACCEL_READY|PIKAFISH READY" gui-c80-accepted-normal.log; grep -q "XQ LINUX PIKAFISH READY" gui-c80-accepted-normal.log

cd /tmp/voice-gui-display; ./xqvoice-display /dev/pango-audio0 /opt/xqvoice/sd77-candidate.xqt 200 160 500 </dev/null >voice-c80-accepted.log 2>&1 & echo $! >voice.pid; sleep 2; cat voice-c80-accepted.log; printf "XQ_STATUS\n" >/run/voice-display.in; sleep 1; tail -4 gui-c80-accepted-normal.log; kill -0 $(cat gui-v3.pid) && kill -0 $(cat voice.pid)
